column3: walks git ls-files over the whole repository (the old-path test), the tracked script files under OspreyFlow_Core/apps/ (the import and collection tests), reads packages/glass-shared (src/index.ts and the sources it names) and the files the slice moved by name (git history of the renames); its plants run on temporary copies, never the real folders

the real-tree cases read the whole of OspreyFlow_Core at HEAD through git ls-tree and git cat-file (read-only), run the script's no-React step on an extracted archive in a temporary folder, and read OspreyFlow_Core/scripts/manifest_areas.toml and the release workflow at HEAD; one case walks the working tree's OspreyFlow_Core/apps/pages and OspreyFlow_Core/packages/glass-shared with rglob into a temporary repository; every other case builds its own git repositories in tmp_path
